土乡，狗窝村的一处破城隍庙内！

曾经。

此地香火正盛，香火绕梁，但如今却早已破败不堪，也成了赵霸等人聚集的地点，一群无所事事的家伙，每日都会来到此地聚集，然后听候大哥的消息。

破旧的城隍庙，经过这群二流子的收拾。

如今，已经干净了一些，至少有了下脚的地方，能够供于他们自己在一块赌博，玩耍，房间内大概五个人，加上赵霸的话就六个人了。

“唉，今天大哥又没来，看来咱们这两天，又要没活咯。”其中一名汉子望了望外面的天色，无奈叹息道。

“咦，二哥，你走路怎么一拐一瘸的？”

“怎么，摔了？”

就在这时。

其中一名汉子望着外面走进来的赵霸，脸上流露出一抹疑惑道。

“鳖犊子玩意，说什么呢？”

“别废话，给我抄上家伙，揍人去！”

赵霸脸上戾气十足道。

“好嘞！”

“二哥，谁惹你了？”

“竟敢把我们二哥打成这个样子，不想活了是不是？”

五个二流子扔掉手中的牌，纷纷抄起自己家伙，跟着赵霸一起朝着石溪村的方向赶了过去。

一群二流子很快到了石溪村。

这大热天的，村口也没什么人，都回家避暑去了，不过赵霸一群人火急火燎的，很快便引起了不少村民的注意，纷纷走出门想要凑热闹，看看这是找谁的麻烦。

“滚蛋！”

然而。

赵霸手中的棍子朝着村民一指，想要出来偷看的村民登时被吓得浑身一个激灵，急忙躲开，有的则是推门回家，见到赵霸等人离的远了后，又跟了出来。

很快。

赵霸等人的身后，倒也是跟了一群好奇心极重的村民，想要看一看热闹。

“赵霸这群二流子来势汹汹，这是打算干哈去？”

“这阵仗，还能干嘛，肯定是去李青山家里找麻烦呗，你没听说啊，昨天晚上赵霸将王守业一家子都给揍了一遍，就是因为听说王春晓和李青山二人厮混，现在这阵仗，肯定是去揍李青山的呗。”

“啥，他未来老丈人都下手揍啊？”

“切，还有什么事情是赵霸干不出来的吗？走完之后，王守业一家还不是服服帖帖的，一个屁都不敢放？”

“啧啧啧，这啥世道啊，赵霸这样的人，还不知道要祸害咱们村子多久呢。”

“这下，李青山一家子可惨了，赵霸这群人下手可是黑着呢，平日里也没少欺负人。”

“李青山那个小瘪犊子，打了这么多野物也不说给我们大家分一分，太自私了，这样的人被赵霸打断腿了才好呢，这样就进不了老林子打野物了，野物就能生的多一点，说不得哪天有个不长眼的野猪，一脑袋撞死在我家墙上呢。”

麻子婶也急匆匆迈着小步子，拎着自家的孙子泥鳅便跟着村民去看热闹，便开口诅咒道。

李青山家门外。

“嘭！”

一道沉闷声响，赵霸一脚将大门踹开，怒斥道：“李青山那个瘪犊子呢，跟我滚出来，快点！”

周围的邻居听到动静后，也纷纷出来看热闹。

李青山大门外，迅速聚集了石溪村的村民，伸手对着李青山家指指点点，好话坏话都有。

老李家距离李青山家不远。

所以，在听到李青山家这边有动静后，便纷纷从家中走过来看看怎么回事。

老李一家子。

李老屯，李大奎，李青书三人带伤，走路都是一拐一瘸的，对李青山那可是恨到了骨子里，恨不得将李青山剥皮抽筋了。

此刻，看到赵霸一群人正在李青山家门口叫阵，纷纷面露大喜之色。

“李青山这小子得罪了赵支书，现在他儿子来找麻烦了，这下可有好戏看了。”

李大奎挤在人群中，望着嚣张的赵霸等人兴奋道。

“这小狼崽子可不仅得罪了赵支书，不是还给赵霸带了绿帽子吗，父子俩都让他得罪了一个遍，赵霸能放过他才怪了。”

“最好，能将这小子两腿都打断，这样就不能进老林子打猎了，就他们家这种大手大脚的开销，用不了多久就要花光积蓄，到时候还是要来求咱们老李家。”

李大奎开口道。

“到时候，把这房子卖掉，柳桂香找个人嫁出去，又能收一笔钱，还有老三这两个小王八犊一辈子的苦力供咱们驱使，也算是不错了。”

Tuxiang, inside a dilapidated City God's Temple in Gouwo Village!

once.

This place is very prosperous and full of incense, but now it has long been dilapidated and has become a gathering place for Zhao Ba and others. A group of idle guys come here to gather every day and wait for news from their elder brother.

The dilapidated City God's Temple was cleaned up by these second-rate people.

Now, it is a bit cleaner, and at least there is a place for them to gamble and play together. There are about five people in the room, and if Zhao Ba is included, there will be six people.

"Alas, my eldest brother didn't come again today. It seems that we will have no life again these two days." One of the men looked at the sky outside and sighed helplessly.

"Hey, second brother, why are you limping when you walk?"

"What, did you fall?"

Just then.

One of the men looked at Zhao Ba who came in from outside, with a trace of doubt on his face.

"Turtle calf thing, what are you talking about?"

"Stop talking nonsense, copy the guy for me and beat him up!"

Zhao Ba said with a fierce expression on his face.

"Okay!"

"Second brother, who messed with you?"

"How dare you beat our second brother like this? You don't want to live anymore, do you?"

The five idiots threw away the cards in their hands, picked up their own weapons, and followed Zhao Ba in the direction of Shixi Village.

A group of second-rate men soon arrived at Shixi Village.

On this hot day, there was no one at the entrance of the village. They all went home to escape the heat. However, Zhao Ba's group of people were so anxious that they quickly attracted the attention of many villagers. They all walked out to join in the fun and see who they were causing trouble for.

"Get out!"

However.

Zhao Ba pointed the stick in his hand at the villagers. The villagers who wanted to come out to take a peek were immediately frightened and hurriedly ran away. Some pushed the door open and went home. When they saw that Zhao Ba and others were far away, they followed him out.

soon.

Behind Zhao Ba and others, there was a group of extremely curious villagers who wanted to take a look at the excitement.

"Zhao Ba and these second-rate scoundrels are coming with force. Are they planning to do harm?"

"What else are we going to do in this fight? I'm definitely going to Li Qingshan's house to cause trouble. Didn't you hear? Zhao Ba beat up Wang Shouye's family last night just because I heard that Wang Chunxiao and Li Qingshan were messing around. Now in this fight, I'm definitely going to beat up Li Qingshan."

"What, his future father-in-law will beat him up?"

"Tch, is there anything else that Zhao Ba can't do? After leaving, aren't Wang Shouye and his family obedient, not even daring to fart?"

"Tsk, tsk, tsk, what kind of world is this? People like Zhao Ba will harm our village for who knows how long."

"Now, Li Qingshan's family is in dire straits. People like Zhao Ba are very cunning, and they often bully others."

"That little bastard Li Qingshan killed so many wild animals without giving any of us a share. It's so selfish. It would be better for such a person to have his legs broken by Zhao Ba. This way he won't be able to go into the old forest to hunt wild animals, and the wild animals will be born more. Who knows, one day a wild boar without eyes will hit his head on the wall of my house and die."

Aunt Mazi also hurriedly took small steps, carried her grandson Niliu, and followed the villagers to watch the fun, and cursed.

Outside Li Qingshan's house.

"Bang!"

With a dull sound, Zhao Ba kicked the door open and shouted angrily: "Where's that bastard Li Qingshan, get out of here with me, hurry up!"

After hearing the commotion, the surrounding neighbors also came out to watch the excitement.

Outside Li Qingshan's gate, the villagers of Shixi Village quickly gathered, pointing at Li Qingshan's house and saying both good and bad things.

Lao Li's house is not far from Li Qingshan's house.

Therefore, after hearing the movement at Li Qingshan's house, they all came over from home to see what was going on.

Lao Li's family.

Li Laotun, Li Dakui, and Li Qingshu were injured and walked with a limp. They hated Li Qingshan to the core and wished they could skin Li Qingshan until he got cramps.

At this moment, when they saw Zhao Ba and a group of people calling for formation in front of Li Qingshan's house, they all looked overjoyed.

"This kid Li Qingshan offended Party Secretary Zhao, and now his son is looking for trouble. Now there's going to be some fun."

Li Dakui squeezed in the crowd and looked at the arrogant Zhao Ba and others and said excitedly.

"This little wolf bastard not only offended Party Secretary Zhao, but he also cuckolded Zhao Ba. Both father and son have offended him over and over again. It's strange that Zhao Ba can let him go."

"The best thing is to break both of this kid's legs so that he can't go hunting in the old forest. With their lavish spending, it won't take long for them to run out of savings. At that time, they will still come to ask our old Li family."

Li Dakui said.

"When the time comes, it will be good to sell this house, find someone to marry Liu Guixiang, collect some money, and have the two little bastards, the third child, to work for us for the rest of their lives. It will be good."
